rules.name: Visa Number Syntax
rules.description: Visa identifier must follow standard alphanumeric prefix and digit sequences.

rules.name: Visa Entry Expiry Validation
rules.description: Visa must be currently valid for entry on current date.

rules.name: Stay Duration Plausibility
rules.description: Authorized stay duration should not exceed maximum duration for declared visa category.

rules.name: Passport Linkage Consistency
rules.description: Passport number linked in visa vignette must match physical passport presented.
